findings.body: Raise: Not done. During an upgrade, another item's earlier-release `forge work` run can hold a chat lock. This branch refuses `forge sync` at this line before `sync.write` refreshes any generated files (`src/forge/sync.py:509-510`); it neither waits for that run nor refreshes the files while leaving its chat alone. The named old-release test asserts that refusal, so it does not prove the Done-when behavior for this case. The refusal also prints a problem and a `Next:` line rather than saying what it is waiting for in one line.
